what_it_does.name: shadcn
what_it_does.summary: Instructions, rule files and one Node script for working with shadcn/ui projects through the shadcn CLI. At load the project context is injected by running npx shadcn@latest info --json, and the agent then searches registries, adds, updates and composes components, applies presets and builds registries, following rules on styling, forms, composition, icons and chat UI. A DESIGN.md workflow scaffolds a new app, maps a brand spec onto the theme and builds a design system page, checked with showcase-coverage.mjs. Use it in any project with a components.json file or when working with shadcn/ui, registries or presets.
tasks: search registries and add or update components with the CLI
compose UI from existing components following the critical rules
build chat and assistant UIs from the chat primitives
initialize projects and apply or switch presets
turn a DESIGN.md or brand spec into a themed app and design system page

risks.risk: Code from third-party registries or GitHub repositories enters the project when the agent adds items from them, widening the supply chain.
risks.severity: SAFE overall by C2, LOW by C3
risks.mitigation: in place in the instructions, preview with --dry-run, --diff and --view and review added files

risks.risk: A changed or compromised shadcn package runs on the machine, since npx shadcn@latest is executed at load and on every command without a pinned version.
Instructions hidden in fetched documentation pages or registry item payloads reach the agent, since their content is read into its context.
risks.mitigation: C2 notes that documentation comes from vendor domains and external files are to be verified

risks.risk: Local changes to components are lost when apply or add --overwrite replaces the component files.
risks.mitigation: in place in the instructions, ask the user first and never use --overwrite without explicit approval

risks.risk: A registry token resolved from an environment variable is sent to whatever URL a registry entry in components.json names.

limitations: GitHub registry addresses support public github.com repositories only, private repos and GitHub Enterprise are not supported.
apply only works in an existing project with a components.json file.
apply --only supports theme and font, icon is not supported because icon changes may require a full component reinstall.
init with neither --preset nor --base stops at an interactive library prompt, even with -y.
Laravel does not support monorepo scaffolding.
Preset codes do not encode the base, so a scratch directory needs --base passed explicitly.
macOS privacy can block reading a DESIGN.md in ~/Downloads or ~/Desktop for some hosts.
Brand fonts are usually licensed, so named substitutes are installed instead.

known_problems.problem: inline Command scrolls its first item into view on mount and jumps the page
known_problems.workaround: control it with value and onValueChange, initial value none

known_problems.problem: the default Sidebar is fixed and escapes the preview frame
known_problems.workaround: use SidebarProvider with min-h-0 and Sidebar collapsible none

known_problems.problem: base Select shows the raw value in SelectValue
Resizable with react-resizable-panels v4 dropped direction and numeric sizes
known_problems.workaround: use orientation horizontal and defaultSize as a percentage

known_problems.problem: hardcoded import paths in third-party registry components
known_problems.workaround: rewrite imports to the ui alias from npx shadcn@latest info

known_problems.problem: root tsc --noEmit checks nothing in Vite apps
cn() drops unknown text-* classes next to color classes
known_problems.workaround: use type-* utilities instead of --text-* theme keys
